name: @algomancy/ledgers
description: Every work queue on the client, in one place. backlog.ts is the non-card work (BL-nn); card-todo.ts is the card/ticket queue (CT-nn) and the biggest of them; playtest-ledger.ts is every owner bug report; card-ledger.ts, claims.ts, unreached.ts and scenario-queue.ts are the derived queues over the pool. These are DATA, not tests — they lived in engine/test/ for historical reasons and reading them as a test suite was the confusion this package removes. backlog.test.ts keeps the entries honest; report.ts answers 'what should I pick up'. No dependencies of its own — it borrows the engine's tsc and @types/node.
